document_title: EES Gemini v0.9.0 Internal Release Readiness Assessment

checks.name: Structural validator
checks.evidence: 32 canonical skills; 74 capability IDs; 222 evaluation contracts; 51 central fixtures; 13 operational fixture projects; no warnings.

checks.name: Operational fixtures
checks.evidence: 13 passed; 0 failed; 0 timed out; agent effectiveness explicitly not evaluated.

checks.name: Focused regression suites
checks.evidence: Previously recorded focused suites passed: 24 tests and 9 subtests; additional canonical merge/routing suite passed 15 tests.

checks.name: Complete pytest suite
checks.evidence: The complete suite did not finish within the execution window. Verbose run stalled around test_risk_classification_v072.py when run after preceding tests; the same test passes in isolation. Do not represent the full suite as passing.

checks.name: Live Gemini integration
checks.evidence: No live Gemini CLI/API execution or provider credential-based validation was performed.

checks.name: Independent security review
checks.evidence: No third-party penetration test, threat-model sign-off, or OS-level sandbox verification is included.

release_blockers: Full pytest suite must complete successfully in a clean CI environment; investigate test-order/environment interaction around test_risk_classification_v072.py.
Run the supported live Gemini integration tests in a controlled environment.
Complete human semantic review of all 32 canonical skills and source-module conflict resolution.
Complete independent security review of command execution, filesystem boundaries, dual runtime surfaces, and sandbox isolation.
scope_limitations: This report is an internal evidence summary, not a third-party certificate, regulatory certification, or production warranty.
Passing structural and focused tests does not prove agent effectiveness, superior intelligence, or production safety.
Production approval requires all release blockers to be closed and evidence attached to the release record.
